history.name: A deliberate order within each size
history.description: The record keeps the order its features were written in, which is what settles their sequence when several share a size. It is maintained as features are added and removed, and a feature it hasn't caught up with simply sorts last rather than causing a problem.
history.dev_notes: .ledger/index.json { order: [...] }, rewritten by Project#saveIndex() on every write; pruned of dead ids, and unknown files appended alphabetically.
